comparison.objective: Hand-guide a Franka arm to a service pose while correctly holding an enabling switch, then teach the pose; candidate mechanically configures a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous force-guiding of a seven-joint arm while maintaining a three-position safety control in its enable band.
comparison.success_condition: Requires pose accuracy, correct button state, Teach actuation, collision avoidance, and clearance; candidate requires a locked opening angle retained over cycles.
comparison.reason: Robot setup relevance is shared, but hand-guiding with an enabling device tests a different physical ability from mechanical stop adjustment.
